from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
import boto3
from django.conf import settings
from .models import LegalAgreement

class AgreementVersionUploadUrlView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, agreement_id):
        agreement = get_object_or_404(LegalAgreement, id=agreement_id, participants=request.user)
        next_version = agreement.current_version + 1
        key = f"legal/{agreement.id}/revisions/v{next_version}.pdf"

        s3 = boto3.client("s3")
        presigned = s3.generate_presigned_url(
            "put_object",
            Params={"Bucket": settings.AWS_LEGAL_BUCKET, "Key": key, "ContentType": "application/pdf"},
            ExpiresIn=600
        )
        return Response({"upload_url": presigned, "version": next_version})
